# cutbg (Remove Background)
> Local-first open-source background remover. Runs RMBG-1.4 in the browser or via a Node CLI. No photo upload to the site.

Images stay on the device. The model downloads from Hugging Face once. Optional color fill and crop in the web UI.

## Agent how-to
- [Remove-background skill](https://cutbg.vercel.app/agent-skills/remove-background/SKILL.md): CLI and `?src=` deep-link instructions for agents
- [agents.txt](https://cutbg.vercel.app/agents.txt): capability declaration
- [agents.json](https://cutbg.vercel.app/agents.json): structured capability catalog

## CLI (preferred for agents)
Clone https://github.com/frenkd/image-editor then:

```bash
npm install
npm run remove-bg -- <input-or-url> [output.png] [options]
```

Useful options: `--color #rrggbb`, `--crop auto`, `--advanced`, `--fill-holes`, `--fill-holes=all`, `--solid`, `--mode ink`, `--ink-max 96`.
See the remove-background skill for the full flag list and logo vs photo tips.

## Web
- App: https://cutbg.vercel.app/
- Deep link: https://cutbg.vercel.app/?src=<image-url>&color=%2300a894&crop=auto&advanced=1
